zh-CN.name: 玻璃拟态
zh-CN.description: 以半透明表面、背景模糊和细致边缘表现磨砂玻璃般的层次。实际内容的可读性取决于背景与表面的组合，不能只看单独一张浅色样稿。
use_when: 内容上方需要一层轻量浮动容器。
背景具备可辨识层次且文本仍有足够对比。
avoid_when: 密集表格或复杂背景容易使文字难读。
不支持模糊或减少透明效果时需要实色回退。
zh-CN.prompt_template: 为少量浮动卡片采用半透明底色、背景模糊与可见边界；文本使用稳定的高对比色，先检查复杂背景；提供不依赖模糊的实色替代，不把所有容器都做成玻璃。

en.name: Glassmorphism
en.description: A visual style using translucent surfaces, blurred backdrops and subtle edges to suggest frosted glass and layered depth. Legibility depends on the combined surface and background, not on an isolated mockup.
use_when: A lightweight floating surface is useful above background content.
Background depth can remain visible without weakening text contrast.
avoid_when: Dense tables and busy backgrounds can make translucent content difficult to read.
Provide an opaque fallback when blur or translucency is unavailable.
en.prompt_template: Use translucency, backdrop blur and visible edges for a small number of floating cards. Keep text contrast stable across busy backgrounds and provide an opaque alternative that works without blur. Avoid applying glass treatment to every container.
